concerns.text: PR deletes LTI launch OpenAPI contract (LtiAuth.openapi.yaml), LTI endpoints, and LtiSsoIntegrationTest, removing previously working LTI SSO functionality.
English Moodle role string pattern matching (e.g. 'admin', 'instructor', 'learner') was removed in mapMoodleRole, which may break role mapping for English Moodle instances.
